issues.issue: Whether BNP acts in 2001-2006 were acts contrary to the purposes and principles of the United Nations (Art. 1F(c))
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says BNP members in his region committed no violence; AL attacked BNP members, who defended themselves.
issues.respondent_position: Minister says BNP leaders and members committed serious, sustained abuses (torture, killings), so Art. 1F(c) applies.
issues.result_quote: BNP leaders and members were indeed guilty of acts contrary to the purposes and principles of the United Nations

issues.issue: Whether the claimant is excluded for crimes against humanity (Art. 1F(a))
issues.applicant_position: Claimant denies personally committing any crimes against humanity.
issues.respondent_position: Minister alleges complicity in crimes against humanity under Art. 1F(a).
issues.result_quote: it is not necessary for the panel to analyze further whether the acts committed by BNP members are crimes against humanity

issues.issue: Whether the claimant was complicit in the BNP acts (six-criteria test)
issues.applicant_position: Says he was a rank-and-file member, was not a key figure, and knew of no violence in his region.
issues.respondent_position: Minister says he was a high-ranking leader who knew of the abuses and personally participated in them.
issues.result_quote: the panel is of the opinion that the claimant was indeed complicit in the commission of acts contrary to the purposes and principles of the United Nations

issues.issue: Whether the claimant is excluded from Convention protection under IRPA section 98
issues.applicant_position: Claimant argues he should not be excluded from Convention protection.
issues.respondent_position: Minister says claimant is excluded under Art. 1F(a) and (c) and IRPA section 98.
issues.result_quote: He is thus excluded from the protection offered by the Convention pursuant to IRPA section 98.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant's fear of return to Bangladesh must be assessed
issues.applicant_position: Claims fear of Awami League members and police if returned to Bangladesh.
issues.result_quote: the panel is not obliged to further assess the issue of the claimant's fear of returning to his own country
